clientgapSummary.toolAssessment: No implementation correctness defect was found against clientgap's documented candidate semantics: wiring.ts explicitly warns that re-export barrels and Trpc inference are blind spots. Precision is poor for this corpus: 15 of 23 hits are live client output types. Track a world-aware enhancement that propagates client-consumed AppRouter procedure outputs back to their named contract declarations, including re-export barrels, Zod inferred aliases, nested constituent types, and composed intersections. Keep server-only and plugin-guest types as candidates or add an explicit consumer-plane classification; do not suppress them by assuming every View/Summary belongs to packages/client.

recommendations.work: Wire connection.verifyAuth on save, accountCredits on the per-row diagnostic tile, and decide/restore the full inspectEndpoint experience in the step-9 connection UI.

Record truthful caller intent for health and the admin registerProvider/dropProvider RPCs. If there is no supported external/admin RPC caller, remove only the wrappers after a separate coupled audit; preserve internal plugin/provider service paths.

Improve clientgap precision by tracing a client-consumed AppRouter procedure output back through router callbacks, service return types, barrels, Zod aliases, nested members, and intersections. The present lens is behaving as documented, so this is an enhancement rather than a false-clean correctness repair.
No contract or procedure deletion is justified solely by these 33 candidates. Preserve the four already-ruled deferred databank/discovery surfaces and all five plugin guest contracts.
